{{Top|leg}}
A '''Tax Chaplain''' was an official in the government and religion of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] species. Visitors to the Ugors' junk-filled [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]] were first greeted by a Tax Chaplain, who then ushered them to a meeting with the higher-ranking [[Chief Tax Chaplain]] to pay the necessary entrance and license fees (viewed as a donation by the Ugors).<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref> Sometime between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref>The date of [[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']] is not given in the adventure, but it must occur within this range, as the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] has been destroyed and [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] has not yet been assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].</ref> the Ugor [[GrrKack]] was a Tax Chaplain.<ref name="SH" />
